items.prompt: Left sorted, target unequal to mid: keep left when?

options.why: A strict lower comparison would wrongly discard target equal to a[lo], whose position has not necessarily been checked.
Since mid is already unequal to target, target at or above a[mid] lies outside the sorted left candidate range.
In a sorted left half, values below a[lo] cannot appear there.
Include the still-eligible left endpoint and exclude the already-tested midpoint: a[lo] <= target < a[mid].

items.explanation: Left endpoint remains eligible; mid was checked.
